blind.B1: Yes; moderate treadmill run vs sedentary gastrocnemius (S3.3.p2, S4.p1, TAB1/S7.3.p2). Exercise factor: Moderate (6) and High (6) runs; Basal (6) sedentary.
blind.B2: Protocol paper: running vs sedentary at ZT14 and ZT22; GEO gives 6 cells n=3 (Basal/Moderate/High x Early ZT14/Late ZT22). No DE comparisons stated.
blind.B3: No repeated animals expected: each gastrocnemius is dissected after the run at one ZT, so the two ZTs are different mice. Letter A/B/C is the only candidate key and is not documented as an animal.

checks.evidence: Paper S3.3.p2/S4.p1: treadmill run vs sedentary gastrocnemius; GEO treatment_protocol_ch1 has Basal/Moderate/High; analysis ran.
Six cells n=3 (title and characteristics fields agree, 18/18). Basal sedentary is the control within each ZT; High arm labelled exploratory (S3.p1). No exclusions.
Contrasts are Moderate (treatment) vs Basal (control) within ZT14 and ZT22; Nr4a3/Hspa1a up as expected.

B3: ZT14 and ZT22 samples are terminal gastrocnemius dissections, so cannot be one mouse; analysis says one muscle per mouse. But packet A key (title letter A/B/C across Early/Late) is expression-supported (r 0.274 vs -0.034, perm p 0.0005). Likely a processing/batch letter or same-letter ordering, not an animal; paper and GEO do not say.
checks.fix: Optional sensitivity: add letter A/B/C as a labelled-assumption block; confirm with Ezagouri 2019 or authors what the letter means. No change to the primary record.

checks.evidence: Paper silent (protocol, no DE analysis). One joint cell-means model on 18 samples; policy open.
No batch/housing/lane recorded; Basal sacrifice time relative to the run is recorded as a caveat (S3.3.p2 gives two options). Letter effect noted under pairing.
Integer STAR counts, DESeq2 appropriate; Excel-mangled symbols repaired and 4 ambiguous rows dropped, recorded.
Paper states no DEG rule (B5); workflow default padj<0.05 applied, audit |log2FC|>1 labelled separately.

summary: 该病例的分析决定与论文一致：中等强度跑步对久坐对照，在ZT14和ZT22分别比较，方向正确，阈值为工作流默认并已说明。唯一标记是标题字母A/B/C的配对候选，表达检验有支持，但两个ZT不可能是同一只小鼠，故判为次要且待确认。
